title: Rehydrate the same pending guidance after a process restart
narrative: A suspended generator run must survive executor or MCP process restart and present the identical pending question. Uses the CheckpointStore / run-store seam from durable resume (`fangore_insp_durable_resume`, `fangore_transactional_durable_resume`) rather than a second recovery protocol. Tracks R-IOC-RESUME[^insp-ioc-05].
implementation: `GeneratorRunStore` (in-memory shared instance or checkpoint-backed) rehydrates `GeneratorRunRecord.pending_request` for a new `DurableGraphGenerator` instance.
validation: Harness `durable_graph_generator` op `durable_survive_restart`. Hard expects identical pending question and request_id after rehydrate.
